question: In a frequency distribution histogram of the mathematics scores of 40 students in a class, the frequencies for the five groups \([50,60)\), \([60,70)\), \([70,80)\), \([80,90)\), and \([90,100]\) are 2, 6, 14, 12, and 6, respectively. How many students scored 60 points or above (including 60)?
solution: Scores of 60 points or above include the last four groups: \(6+14+12+6=38\) students.

How many students scored 60 points or above (including 60)?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Add the included groups

Scores of 60 points or above include the last four groups: \(6+14+12+6=38\) students.

Method 2: Subtract the excluded group

Only the group \([50,60)\) is below 60, and it contains 2 students. Every other student scored at least 60, since 60 belongs to \([60,70)\). Subtracting the excluded group from the class total gives \(40-2=38\) students.
